032502: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_cleanup_target_has_calls(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, CScopeId target_scope, u32 target_token)
032503: {
032504:     if (builder->cleanup_entities && builder->cleanup_flags)
032505:     {
032506:         for (u32 cleanup_index = builder->cleanup_flag_count; cleanup_index != 0; cleanup_index -= 1)
032507:         {
032508:             u32 entry_index = builder->cleanup_flag_base + cleanup_index - 1;
032509:             CEntityId entity_id = builder->cleanup_entities[entry_index];
032510:             CEntity* entity = entity_id.value < builder->parse.entity_count ? &builder->parse.entities[entity_id.value] : 0;
032511:             if (entity && entity->has_cleanup && builder->cleanup_flags[cleanup_index - 1].value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID &&
032512:                 c_ir_cleanup_is_outside_target(&builder->parse, entity, target_scope, target_token) && c_ir_find_local_by_entity(builder, entity_id))
032513:             {
032514:                 return true;
032515:             }
032516:         }
032517:     }
032518: 
032519:     return false;
032520: }

032522: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_emit_cleanup_calls(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, CIrBodyTask* tasks, u32 task_count, CScopeId target_scope,
032523:                                                   u32 target_token, IrSourceRange source)
032524: {
032525:     for (u32 cleanup_index = builder->cleanup_flag_count; cleanup_index != 0; cleanup_index -= 1)
032526:     {
032527:         u32 entry_index = builder->cleanup_flag_base + cleanup_index - 1;
032528:         CEntityId entity_id = builder->cleanup_entities[entry_index];
032529:         CEntity* entity = entity_id.value < builder->parse.entity_count ? &builder->parse.entities[entity_id.value] : 0;
032530:         if (!entity || !entity->has_cleanup || builder->cleanup_flags[cleanup_index - 1].value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID ||
032531:             !c_ir_cleanup_is_outside_target(&builder->parse, entity, target_scope, target_token))
032532:         {
032533:             continue;
032534:         }
032535:         CIntegerIrLocal* local = c_ir_find_local_by_entity(builder, entity_id);
032536:         if (!local)
032537:         {
032538:             continue;
032539:         }
032540:         IrFunction* callback_function = 0;
032541:         CIrSignature callback_signature = {0};
032542:         bool callback_resolved = c_ir_cleanup_function_target(builder, entity->cleanup_function, &callback_function, &callback_signature);
032543:         IrTypeId variable_type = entity->type.value < builder->parse.type_count ? builder->c_type_ir_map[entity->type.value] : IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
032544:         if (!callback_resolved || variable_type.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID || callback_signature.parameter_count != 1)
032545:         {
032546:             return false;
032547:         }
032548:         CToken callback_token = c_ir_space_name_token(builder, entity->name);
032549:         IrValueId flag = builder->cleanup_flags[cleanup_index - 1];
032550:         IrValueId active = c_ir_emit_load_place_raw(builder, flag, builder->bool_type, source);
032551:         active = active.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID ? IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID : c_ir_truth_value(builder, active, source);
032552:         IrBlockId call_block = c_ir_block_create(builder);
032553:         IrBlockId next_block = c_ir_block_create(builder);
032554:         if (active.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID || call_block.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID || next_block.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
032555:         {
032556:             return false;
032557:         }
032558:         IrBlockId targets[2] = {call_block, next_block};
032559:         if (!c_ir_terminate(builder, IR_OPCODE_BRANCH_IF, &active, 1, targets, 2, source) || !c_ir_switch_block(builder, call_block))
032560:         {
032561:             return false;
032562:         }
032563:         IrValueId address = c_ir_emit_address_of_place(builder, local->place, variable_type, source);
032564:         IrValueId arguments[1] = {address};
032565:         arguments[0] = c_ir_emit_cast(builder, arguments[0], callback_signature.parameter_types[0], source);
032566:         if (address.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID || arguments[0].value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID ||
032567:             c_ir_emit_call_target(builder, callback_token, callback_function, callback_signature, arguments, BUSTER_ARRAY_LENGTH(arguments)).value ==
032568:                 IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
032569:         {
032570:             return false;
032571:         }
032572:         IrValueId inactive = c_ir_emit_integer_value_typed(builder, 0, false, callback_token, builder->bool_type);
032573:         if (inactive.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID || !c_ir_emit_store_place(builder, flag, builder->bool_type, inactive, source) ||
032574:             !c_ir_terminate(builder, IR_OPCODE_BRANCH, 0, 0, &next_block, 1, source) || !c_ir_switch_block(builder, next_block))
032575:         {
032576:             return false;
032577:         }
032578:     }
032579:     BUSTER_UNUSED(tasks);
032580:     BUSTER_UNUSED(task_count);
032581:     return true;
032582: }

032584: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_emit_computed_goto_cleanup_dispatch(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrValueId target, IrBlockId* targets, u32 target_count,
032585:                                                                   CIrLabel* labels, u32 label_count, CScopeId root_scope, IrSourceRange source)
032586: {
032587:     if (!target_count || (!c_ir_is_computed_goto_target(builder, target) && !c_ir_is_computed_goto_storage_target(builder, target)))
032588:     {
032589:         if (!builder->failure_message.length)
032590:         {
032591:             builder->failure_message = S8("computed goto requires a function-local void pointer label value");
032592:         }
032593:         return false;
032594:     }
032595:     IrType* target_type = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, builder->function->values[target.value].canonical_type);
032596:     IrBlockId* cleanup_blocks = arena_allocate(builder->arena, IrBlockId, target_count);
032597:     bool needs_dispatch = ir_value_label_metadata(builder->function, target).has_non_label_provenance || !c_ir_is_computed_goto_target(builder, target);
032598:     for (u32 target_index = 0; target_index < target_count; target_index += 1)
032599:     {
032600:         CIrLabel* label = 0;
032601:         for (u32 label_index = 0; label_index < label_count; label_index += 1)
032602:         {
032603:             if (labels[label_index].block.value == targets[target_index].value)
032604:             {
032605:                 label = labels + label_index;
032606:                 break;
032607:             }
032608:         }
032609:         if (!label)
032610:         {
032611:             builder->failure_message = S8("computed goto target does not belong to this function");
032612:             return false;
032613:         }
032614:         CScopeId target_scope = c_parse_scope_for_token(&builder->parse, root_scope, label->token_index);
032615:         if (c_ir_cleanup_target_has_calls(builder, target_scope, label->token_index))
032616:         {
032617:             cleanup_blocks[target_index] = c_ir_block_create(builder);
032618:             if (cleanup_blocks[target_index].value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
032619:             {
032620:                 return false;
032621:             }
032622:             needs_dispatch = true;
032623:         }
032624:         else
032625:         {
032626:             cleanup_blocks[target_index] = IR_BLOCK_ID_INVALID;
032627:         }
032628:     }
032629:     if (!needs_dispatch)
032630:     {
032631:         return c_ir_terminate(builder, IR_OPCODE_INDIRECT_BRANCH, &target, 1, targets, target_count, source);
032632:     }
032633:     if (!target_type || target_type->kind != IR_TYPE_POINTER)
032634:     {
032635:         builder->failure_message = S8("computed goto target must retain its function-local pointer type");
032636:         return false;
032637:     }
032638:     IrBlockId invalid = c_ir_block_create(builder);
032639:     if (invalid.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
032640:     {
032641:         return false;
032642:     }
032643:     for (u32 target_index = 0; target_index < target_count; target_index += 1)
032644:     {
032645:         IrValueId label_value = c_ir_emit_label_address(builder, targets[target_index], source);
032646:         IrType* label_type = label_value.value < builder->function->value_count
032647:                                  ? ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, builder->function->values[label_value.value].canonical_type)
032648:                                  : 0;
032649:         if (label_value.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID || !label_type || label_type->id.value != target_type->id.value)
032650:         {
032651:             builder->failure_message = S8("computed goto target must retain its original void pointer type");
032652:             return false;
032653:         }
032654:         IrValueId equal = c_ir_emit_binary_value(builder, target, label_value, builder->bool_type, IR_BINARY_POINTER_EQUAL, source);
032655:         IrBlockId match = cleanup_blocks[target_index].value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID ? targets[target_index] : cleanup_blocks[target_index];
032656:         if (equal.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
032657:         {
032658:             return false;
032659:         }
032660:         if (target_index + 1 < target_count)
032661:         {
032662:             IrBlockId next = c_ir_block_create(builder);
032663:             IrBlockId branch_targets[2] = {match, next};
032664:             if (next.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID || !c_ir_terminate(builder, IR_OPCODE_BRANCH_IF, &equal, 1, branch_targets, 2, source) ||
032665:                 !c_ir_switch_block(builder, next))
032666:             {
032667:                 return false;
032668:             }
032669:         }
032670:         else
032671:         {
032672:             IrBlockId branch_targets[2] = {match, invalid};
032673:             if (!c_ir_terminate(builder, IR_OPCODE_BRANCH_IF, &equal, 1, branch_targets, 2, source) || !c_ir_switch_block(builder, invalid))
032674:             {
032675:                 return false;
032676:             }
032677:             IrSourceRange unreachable_source = source;
032678:             IrInstruction unreachable = c_ir_instruction_initialize(IR_OPCODE_UNREACHABLE, builder->void_type);
032679:             if (c_ir_append_instruction(builder, unreachable, unreachable_source).value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
032680:             {
032681:                 return false;
032682:             }
032683:             builder->function->blocks[invalid.value].terminated = true;
032684:         }
032685:     }
032686:     for (u32 target_index = 0; target_index < target_count; target_index += 1)
032687:     {
032688:         if (cleanup_blocks[target_index].value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
032689:         {
032690:             continue;
032691:         }
032692:         CIrLabel* label = 0;
032693:         for (u32 label_index = 0; label_index < label_count; label_index += 1)
032694:         {
032695:             if (labels[label_index].block.value == targets[target_index].value)
032696:             {
032697:                 label = labels + label_index;
032698:                 break;
032699:             }
032700:         }
032701:         if (!label || !c_ir_switch_block(builder, cleanup_blocks[target_index]))
032702:         {
